reason: I grab my drink at the station shop on the way to a shift, and this isn't there. I'm not ordering cans online or sitting in a café for one, and at 55 CZK it costs more than the Monster Ultra I already drink, which has no sugar either.
objection: Every brand says natural now, and the YEAHRBA mate I can get on Rohlík is cheaper. I don't see what makes this worth more, and I can't buy it where I actually buy drinks.
would_change_my_mind: Having it in the fridge at the metro station shop for around 40 CZK, so I could try one instead of my usual can.
